SELECT audit_ts::date AS d, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status='on shelf') AS on_shelf, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status='empty') AS empty, COUNT(*) AS total
FROM store.shelf_audits
WHERE sku='ATTA-WW-5KG' AND audit_ts >= '2026-06-01' AND audit_ts < '2026-07-01'
GROUP BY d ORDER BY d;

SELECT date, book_on_hand_close FROM store.inventory_book

WHERE sku='ATTA-WW-5KG' AND date >= '2026-06-01' AND date <= '2026-06-30' ORDER BY date;
SELECT MIN(date), MAX(date), COUNT(*) FROM store.daily_sales;

SELECT audit_ts::date AS d, COUNT(*) AS audits,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status='on shelf') AS on_shelf,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status='empty') AS empty
FROM store.shelf_audits
GROUP BY d ORDER BY d;
SELECT audit_ts, sku, status FROM store.shelf_audits WHERE status='empty' ORDER BY audit_ts;

SELECT date, sku, book_on_hand_close FROM store.inventory_book
